stories.title: In About-Face, British Museum Bans Photography of Bayeux Tapestry
stories.sum: Photography is no longer permitted in front of the Bayeux Tapestry at the British Museum, according to Maxwell Museums, the blog run by arts writer Maxwell Blowfield.

stories.title: Amazon doesn’t trust Meta’s Muse AI agent
stories.sum: Meta's Muse AI agent has been blocked from shopping Amazon on behalf of its users, GeekWire reports.

stories.title: The Book of Alison Knowles
stories.sum: A retrospective traces the language of bookmaking in her expansive work and its radical influence on American art.

stories.title: The Big Review: Lucas Museum of Narrative Art ★★★½
stories.sum: While the swooping building is impressive and easy to navigate, the collection is patchy and the displays are at times “bizarre”

stories.title: Amar Kanwar review: unflinching Indian artist dares you to step into the darkness (literally)
stories.sum: Serpentine North, London Making lyrical films for over 40 years, about everything from the end of empire to sexual brutality, Kanwar focuses on the parts of gruesome stories that are often missed The exhibition begins…

stories.title: Inside the Self-Enclosed Universe of Henri Alexander Levy
stories.sum: The founder of the cult fashion label Enfants Riches Déprimés speaks about discipline, self-destruction, and why provocation, for him, was never the point. Louis Lu

stories.title: Trump rejects AI slowdown calls, launches "AI Force" instead
stories.sum: The president offered few details on what his proposed new AI Force would do.

stories.title: Don’t be fooled by this summer of AI hype
stories.sum: It’s been a busy few months for AI hype. At the end of April, Anthropic claimed that its model Claude Mythos is better at finding software vulnerabilities than most security experts.

stories.title: Elon Musk Has Pledged to Rid His Platform, X, of Child Sexual Abuse, but It Persists
stories.sum: Reviews by the Canadian Center for Child Protection and The New York Times found that explicit images of children remain on the social media site owned by Elon Musk.

stories.title: ACCA’s landmark commissioning series is back, as NEW26 showcases the next generation of artists
stories.sum: NEW26 spotlights seven artists from around Australia in Melbourne’s leading contemporary art space.

stories.title: Amid affordability crisis for artists, Vancouver’s city council establishes cultural land trust
stories.sum: The model—already deployed in San Francisco, Helsinki and London—aims to protect creative communities from rampant real estate speculation and development

stories.title: Templo’s visual identity for DeafCity Hub is a fusion of creative coding, British sign language and gestural motion capture
stories.sum: Aiming to move beyond the spoken word, Templo teams up with DeafCity Hub to create purpose-driven campaign visuals that centre and celebrate Deaf culture.

stories.title: Venice Pavilions That Missed the Mark
stories.sum: What we didn’t like at the Biennale, artists pulled out of documenta 16 over Gaza, visitors arrested for hanging paintings by Mona Lisa, and more.

stories.title: French Artist Claude Lévêque Ordered to Stand Trial for Rape and Sexual Assault of Minors
stories.sum: His lawyers have appealed the judges’ decision, likely delaying the long-awaited trial further.
